stage1.impression: A dark, warm bar shot down a long counter toward a black shopfront. The fluted counter front, the record wall and the pendants hold together, but the floor's blotchy large-scale staining, the flat black chair backs and the black void at the far end read as CG. The hanging coloured globe reads as a wireframe of four neon hoops rather than thick glowing acrylic discs. As it stands a magazine would see a generic dark bar, made specific only by the globe and the record wall, and it would not run it.

blocking_9: The shopfront and street must read as a lit San Francisco street at night, not a black void (far-end region median at least 12, crush under 10 %).
Mother EARF must read as six thick cast-acrylic discs with glowing rims and visible faces, not as four thin neon hoops.
The concrete floor must read as polished, board-scale concrete with real reflections of the pendants, not large blotchy stains.
The banquette zone needs pools of light from the Orbs on the tabletops and some sign of life (glasses, a record, a coat) so the left half is not dead.
The foreground chair backs need texture (leather or steel sheen) and must not block the lower-right corner as flat black slabs.
The back-bar Tropos in its niche must read at a glance as a lit acrylic speaker (niche median at least 65).

defects.what: The shopfront and street are a black void: median 4.6, crush 27 %. Only the reversed EARF letters and two specks of light are visible.
Mother EARF reads as thin neon wire hoops. Only four rims read (red, blue, green, olive), the disc faces are nearly invisible, and the region's p95 is only 80.
The floor concrete has large blotchy dark stains that read as low-frequency procedural noise or wet patches, with no polish and no pendant reflections.
The banquette zone is underlit: median 15.8, crush 11.7 %. The Orbs glow but throw no pools on the tables.
The foreground chair backs are flat, featureless black slabs, and one is cut by the frame edge, closing off the corner.
The nearest stool seat is a flat grey disc (median 102) that pulls the eye down out of the frame.
The back-bar Tropos reads as a dull grey box with a woofer (median 52). The acrylic body does not glow and could be any hi-fi cabinet.
A pale diagonal streak of haze near the ceiling, unexplained by any visible source. It reads as an artefact.
A uniform added grain over the whole frame, plus smooth CG surfaces on the zinc and the stools.

changes.problem: The far end, the shopfront and the street at night that the frame is meant to look toward, is a black void.

change.to: 2 street lamps outside the glass, about 3000 K, enough to light the far pavement and a parked car or building face across the street, plus a soft 3500 K fill on the facade opposite

changes.expected: The shopfront glass reads as a window onto a lit street, the reversed EARF lettering silhouettes against it, and the room gains depth.

changes.problem: Mother EARF, the room's centrepiece, reads as thin neon hoops, not thick polished acrylic discs.

evidence.measured: lum_median 13.5, p95 80, disc faces near black, 4 of 6 rims legible

change.to: 0.12, with a weak second spot (about 40 W, 3000 K, wide cone) grazing the disc faces from camera side so the 25 mm faces catch reflections

changes.expected: All six tinted rims glow and the disc faces show soft reflections, so it reads as a solid acrylic object.

changes.problem: The floor's blotchy large stains and matte finish read as CG and give no pools of reflected light.

evidence.measured: lum_median 26.6, p95 71, visible 30-60 cm cloud-like dark patches at 2x

change.setting: the floor's polish and the concrete's tone
change.to: honed or polished concrete (roughness about 0.25), staining contrast cut by about two thirds, a finer aggregate and saw-cut joints

changes.expected: Soft reflections of the pendants and counter glow streak across the floor, and the stains become subtle.

changes.problem: The banquette zone is dead dark. The Orbs glow but light nothing.
changes.expected: Warm pools on each tabletop and the banquette back, with dark between them.

changes.problem: The back-bar Tropos does not read as a lit acrylic speaker.

evidence.measured: lum_median 52, grey cabinet with no edge glow

change.setting: on each Ember speaker, area lights
change.to: 3.0 W/m2, plus a 16 deg, 8 W, 2700 K top spot into each back-bar niche

changes.expected: The smoked acrylic body glows from within, with polished edges catching a line of light.

changes.problem: The foreground chair backs block the lower-right corner as flat black slabs, and the nearest stool seat drags the eye out of frame.

evidence.measured: chair backs near 0 luminance, seat median 102

change.to: about [11.4, 2.6, 1.25], slid back and to the right so that no stool back is cut by the right or bottom edge, aim unchanged

changes.expected: The counter run reads cleanly from the corner and the eye goes down the zinc to the street.

changes.problem: The banquette tables are bare, so the left half has no sign of life.

evidence.measured: visual: tables hold only the Orbs

change.to: a rocks glass and a napkin on each of the two nearest banquette tables, a record sleeve leaning on the banquette back

changes.expected: Small highlights on the glass in the Orb pools and an occupied, lived-in zone.

changes.problem: The chair backs and stool seats read as smooth CG solids.

evidence.measured: visual: no grain, sheen or stitching at 1:1

change.setting: the materials' finish (seat leather and backs)
change.to: dark aniline leather with a soft sheen (roughness about 0.45) and slight wear on the edges

changes.expected: The backs pick up rim highlights from the counter glow and read as upholstered furniture.

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs read thicker or more solid in shape.
out_of_scope.why: Its shape and colours are fixed by the owner. Only its light can change (c2).

out_of_scope.request: Give the back-bar Tropos a visible tint so it reads as the hero speaker.
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration and the speaker's colour are fixed. Only its lighting can change (c5).
